MIND. [1] [Carb. ac.]
Insensibility.
Loss of memory.
(In sick :) Forgetfulness, she cannot remember anything, becomes easily confused.
(In sick :) She starts to do something and forgets it.
(In sick :) She has difficulty of remembering events that have passed.
(In sick :) She has periods of mental abstraction.
Absentminded, starts when spoken to, nervous tremor.
Inability to fix mind on anything or retain what is read.
Muddled and confused.
(In sick :) She had sense of bewilderment.
Mind unusually clear, desirous for intellectual work.
Entire disinclination to study ; what he had accomplished seemed very trifling.
Disinclination to mental efforts, event to read.
Disinclination for mental or bodily labor.
Constantly agitated, moaning continuously and occasionally uttering a piercing cry ; recognizes no one. θ Acute hydrocephalus.
Depressed ; morose ; irritable.
Fear of impending sickness, evening in bed.
Very irritable.
(In sick :) She became petulant and impatient although naturally good, quiet and gentle.
Mental and physical exhilaration.
Restless : cries out in sleep ; t. θ Meningitis.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Carb. ac.]
Felt as if staggering, like a drunken man.
Giddiness, not > by shutting eyes.
Vertigo : on going up and down stairs ; > by walking fast in open air, < by sitting down, fear of falling ; with trembling.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Carb. ac.]
Aching and burning pain in forehead, > by pressure of cold hand.
Dull frontal headache in centre of forehead.
Dull frontal headache : with chilliness ; with general lassitude ; > in open air.
Feeling of tightness across forehead, directly above frontal sinuses.
Dull frontal headache, as if an india-rubber band was stretched tightly over forehead, from temple to temple.
Frontal headache and oppression of chest, going left to right.
(In sick :) Intense pressing pains through temples and in top of head ; even down to nape of neck, stiffness and soreness were felt.
(In sick :) She had severe semilateral headache, extending over vertex, this entire surface was sensitive to touch.
Burning pain in right temple and vertex.
Dull, heavy pain through temples, with tight band across forehead, and tightness in nose between eyes.
Pressure in left temple, seemingly on surface of brain.
Twitching pain through temples, neuralgic pains in left.
Jagging pain in head, < from light and noise.
Sharp, darting neuralgic pain in head, changing situation from one side to the other.
Dull pain running from forehead to occiput.
Burning pain in top of head.
Sensation as of fine electric sparks in vertex, changing to a prickling, itching, > by rubbing.
Feeling in top of head as if brain was swashing about.
Headache in upper half of head, in morning.
Dull pressure and pain in occiput and muscles of back of neck, especially just behind ears.
Expansive pains in head, with swimming before eyes.
Head felt as if enclosed in a band, which at times seemed to compress and crush in head, < in temples.
Fulness of head all over brain, with dull pains.
Head feels very heavy.
Numbness in head after reading, with pressure in temples.
Headache, with nausea, > by a cup of green tea.
Pressure or a tight bandage, > headache temporarily, also > while smoking after tea ; < bending head forward.
Reading < pressure in occiput.
Severe burning in brain, over eyebrows in evening.
(In sick :) Her brain throbbed and entire head ached.
Rush of blood to head, face flushed.
Congestive headache.
Basilar meningitis ; acute hydrocephalus.
Periodical spells of sick headache, about time of catamenia.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Carb. ac.]
Tinea capitis ; vermin on head ; itching of scalp.
Scalp sensitive to touch, could not comb or brush hair.
Sweat on head from least exertion.
Sensation of coldness, like cold sensation experienced when nerve of tooth is touched, in one spot on head, stooping, followed by clammy sweat.
Cold clammy moisture on head.
Feels like rubbing head and eyes.
Retraction of head. θ Hydrocephalus
Small pustulous vesicle a little to left of vertex.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Carb. ac.]
Cannot see across room.
Sensitive to light ; headache.
Swimming before eyes.
Constant dark spot in front of left eye.
Letters seem to run together while writing.
Things look as if they were moving backward and forward.
Pupils contracted and insensible to light ; t.
Alternate contraction and dilatation of pupils. θ Hydrocephalus.
Neuralgic twitching in eyeballs.
Eyelids open, move up and down constantly ; t.
Very severe orbital neuralgia over right eye.
Neuralgia of right eye and temple.
Slight pain over right eyebrow ; the same kind of pain, but in a milder degree, under right patella ; both of short duration.
Acute piercing pain in a small spot on left supraorbital ridge before rising ; spot remains sore to touch.
Watering of left eye and watery discharge from nose, in evening.
Pains in head affect eye of painful side so much, it is difficult to keep it open.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Carb. ac.]
Pressing pain in left ear, transient.
(In sick :) She had a tingling, numb feeling in ear, followed by humming, buzzing sound.
(In sick :) Beating pain with a humming sound in both ears.
(In sick :) Meatus auditorius externum excoriated and covered with small pustular eruption, extending inward.
Pain from throat extends into ear.
Itching of right ear.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Carb. ac.]
Smell more acute.
Watery discharge from both nostrils, in open air, > indoors, returning when entering a cold room. θ Coryza.
Fetid discharge from nose. θ Diphtheria.
(In sick :) Same secretion was blown from nose as was hawked from throat.
Stinging in left nostril, with watery discharge from nose and eye.
Both nostrils plugged up.
When blowing nose, mucus bloody, or bright red blood.
Nasal membrane so tumefied, must breathe through mouth. θ Scarlatina.
Feeling of expansion in nasal passage, when walking out of doors.
Tightness in nose between eyes.
Sensation at left wing of nose as of fine electric sparks, wants to rub the part repeatedly.
Itching of nose.
Nasal catarrh, ozæna, discharge very offensive.
Epithelioma on nose.
A small vesicle formed on centre of nose.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Carb. ac.]
Face sensitive to touch of towel.
Face flushed and burns. θ Headache.
Face pale ; and anxious.
White circle around mouth, rest of face dusky red. θ Scarlatina.
Sallow, soapy and bloodless complexion.
Twitching in cheeks and temples.
Drawing pain in jaw, right side.
Sharp pain about centre of cheek, as if bitten by a mosquito.
Itching of face ; of right cheek.
A momentary chill runs from face downward, in a hot room.
Slight pustular eruption on right side of face.
Lupus of face.
Cold sweat on face ; t.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Carb. ac.]
Slight lividity of lips ; t.
Lips dry, cracked, painful or black. θ Scarlatina.
Burning on lips.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Carb. ac.]
Aching of teeth of right upper jaw. θ Toothache.
Grinding of teeth. θ Hydrocephaloid.
Sordes.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Carb. ac.]
Coppery metallic taste on tongue and upper palate.
Burning and tingling of tongue, as if a thousand pins were pricking it.
Burning of tongue, especially on tip.
Biting sensation on tongue.
Not able to protrude tongue.
Tongue trembling and like raw beef.
Tongue dry and chippy ; parched and fissured.
Tongue : white ; dark brown ; thick, yellow white fur down centre (scarlatina) ; red papillæ project here and there ; shiny, glossy, dry coating ; covered with thick yellow fur.
Tongue dark brown coat, sordes. θ Remittent autumnal fever.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Carb. ac.]
Profuse secretion of bluish-white frothy saliva.
Foaming at mouth ; t.
Mouth and throat full of thick, viscid mucus.
Swelling and soreness of inner side of left cheek, opposite molars.
Thrush, aphthæ, stomatitis.
Mouth and tongue black, sordes and ulcerated patches on inside of lips and cheeks. θ Scarlatina.
Intensely bad smell from mouth. θ Diphtheria. θ Scarlatina. θ Constipation.
White hardened or corrugated patches of mucous membranes ; t.
Breath fetid and repulsive. θ Scarlatina.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Carb. ac.]
Fauces fiery red, swollen ; diphtheritic patches ; breath almost unbearable. θ Scarlatina.
Dryness of posterior nares.
Full feeling in throat, with constant desire to swallow.
Liquids, on being swallowed, return by nose. θ Scarlatina.
Choking feeling in throat, with disposition to hawk up phlegm.
Hawking of mucus from pharynx and posterior nares.
(In sick :) Tingling, burning, dryness in throat ; later soreness, tumefaction and swelling of surrounding structures.
Sharp stitches in throat.
Burning in throat and œsophagus, with heat, rising up from stomach.
Entire pharynx, uvula and velum palati looked glazed, had reddish, pearly hue, not unlike early manifestations of diphtheria ; tonsils were swollen and involved in like manner.
Diphtheria ; exudation imbedded in mucous membrane with fetor oris.
Fauces covered with exudate, glands of neck swollen, aphonia, croup-like cough, fetid discharge from nose, violent fever, pulse 130. θ Diphtheria.
Spasmodic contraction of œsophagus.
Mucous membrane of œsophagus dry, brownish, shrunken.
Soreness of throat, < on right side.
Pain in throat extending to ear.
Throat > while smoking after tea (supper).
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Carb. ac.]
Loss of all appetite.
Excessive thirst.
(In sick :) Thirst and dryness of mouth and lips ; > by cooling drinks.
Desire for whisky and tobacco.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Carb. ac.]
Felt as if she had eaten too much.
While eating a little breakfast, felt every now and then as if he had to get up and vomit.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Carb. ac.]
Hiccough after dinner.
Nausea : from cold water ; in morning ; in throat.
Constant belching up of wind from stomach. θ Constipation.
Fruitless eructations.
Acid eructations and formation of gas.
(In sick :) Sometimes sweetish regurgitation, at other times bitter or sour, or like buttermilk and cabbage.
Vomiting of dark olive green or back fluid ; t.
Vomiting, with great restlessness ; t.
Vomiting. θ Pregnancy. θ Seasickness. Cancer.
Vomiting ; of drunkards ; vomits everything taken into stomach. θ Bright's disease.
Chronic vomiting, sarcinæ in vomit.
